# Benchmark concurrencies<AvailableFrom v="3.2.28" />

Specify which concurrency values should be used while benchmarking. Multiple values can be passed separated by comma. Learn more about [concurrency](/docs/terminology/concurrency).

## CLI flag

```text
--concurrencies <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setBenchmarkConcurrencies('1,4,8');
```
